text:
incidents-bot: ALERT: Elevated 5xx (502/504) observed on apigw-prod (eu-west) · auto-detected by telemetry · severity: high · paging @ben-oncall · link: https://ops.redwood.ai/alerts/2894042023 :rotating_light:
ben-oncall: Oncall here — I'm looking. Spike started ~00:12 UTC, 2.3k 5xx in last 2m. Pulling ingress logs now.
alice-dev: I see many upstream 502s from inference-edge (inference-edge-2). p50 latency fine, p95 up ~600ms. Sample error: `upstream response code 502 while reading response header from upstream`
sam-sre: I'll check routing. Hypothesis: fastpath routing to optimized mux is causing backpressure to upstream replicas. Planning to toggle fastpath routing for EU.
linda-pm: Customer impact note: support reported uptick in errors for EU customers on conversational endpoints. Logging a CS ticket. Anyone on-call for dedicated customers?
ben-oncall: Rolling plan: disable fastpath route rule for eu-west for 5 minutes and monitor. Command: ```bash
curl -s -X POST https://config.redwood.internal/apigw/routes/fastpath/disable \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \ 
  -d '{"region":"eu-west","duration_s":300}'
```
incidents-bot: ACTION: Route change requested · rollout id=roll-2894-fastpath-01 · status=started
alice-dev: Also enabling "deg_mode" (degradation mode) on inference-edge so it reduces fanout and returns cached fallbacks. Will run the enable script.
ben-oncall: Command to enable deg_mode: ```json
POST /internal/edge/control
{"mode":"deg_mode","targets":["inference-edge-*"],"ttl_s":600}
```
sam-sre: Fastpath toggle confirmed applied (config service ack). Observing ~35% drop in 502s within 45s.
ben-oncall: Deg_mode enabled across edges, logs: `deg_mode: active, fanout_limit=2`
alice-dev: KV cache thrash observed earlier — some nodes showing repeated cache misses. Flushing caches on edge nodes x{1..6}: `ssh edge-node-$i 'sudo systemctl restart edge-cache'`
sam-sre: Cache flush done for nodes 1-6. Confirming connection pools stabilized.
ben-oncall: 5xx rate down from 2300/min to ~600/min in eu-west. p95 latency trending down. Marking mitigation effective.
linda-pm: Thanks team. Updating customer incident status: "partial degradation, mitigated; continued monitoring"
ben-oncall: Keeping this thread open for monitoring window. I'll hand off to night oncall in 20m — @derek-night will take over once I drop. :thumbsup:
derek-night: ACK — I'll watch dashboards and will escalate if errors climb back. Please DM if anything else.
incidents-bot: INCIDENT: mitigation applied · monitoring period started · next reminder in 15m
ben-oncall: Leaving notes: root cause investigation ticket created (ENG-IR-4721) to trace why fastpath routing amplified upstream failures. Will add logs + heap of traces. Handoff done.
derek-night: Received handoff, will keep an eye and reopen if trend reverses. Good work team.
